worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.summary: Darts in and clamps down with hard gills before the target reacts: the power doubles when the target has not struck the user, and the bite drags the target in and lowers its Speed.
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.use.0: Bite before the foe can act
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.use.1: Drag a target back to the user
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.use.2: Clamp down and slow the prey
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.descripti: Deals about %1$s physical damage; the power doubles when the target has not struck the user in the last %2$s seconds and is not swinging at the user right now.
Lunges up to %1$s blocks at %2$s blocks per tick, with a %3$s block bite radius.
A landed bite drags the target up to %1$s blocks toward the user and lowers its Speed by %2$s stages.
Deep bite on: the drag is 0.4 blocks longer and one more Speed stage is pressed down, pinning the prey; costs 3 ticks more prepare and 6 ticks more cooldown.
Deep bite off: a quick snap with a short drag and a single Speed stage, at a shorter prepare and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.timing: Castable on enemies within %1$s blocks; commits after %2$s s and costs %4$s PP; recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.growth.0: At level %1$s the gill bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.growth.1: At level %1$s the gill bite power rises to %2$s and the lunge distance to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.fishiousrend.preferenc: On: the drag is 0.4 blocks longer and one more Speed stage is pressed down, pinning the prey, but prepare takes 3 ticks and cooldown 6 ticks more. Off: a quick snap with a short drag and a single Speed stage, quicker and cheaper.
Only lunges at threats this close; a larger value chases further before biting.
On: bites are prioritised while the target has not struck the user. Off: sorted like an ordinary melee attack.
